title: Ravelry Metric0 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ravelry:metric0 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for ravelry metric0 data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for ravelry metric0 events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It treats the smoothed week-long trend in your value from ravelry metric0.
